# Pack

A pack is a named, versioned selection of library entries, in `danbyte/packs/<id>/pack.yaml`. `danbyte-lib build-pack` turns it into the zip Danbyte installs (pack import, online or air-gapped); the catalog shows each entry's pack, version, licence and author. Entries are named `<Vendor>/<NAME>`, as their file paths under the matching folder.

Schema: [`danbyte/schema/pack.schema.json`](../../schema/pack.schema.json) (danbyte-library/v1).

Files: `danbyte/packs/<id>/pack.yaml`. Start each with the editor line, so VS Code (YAML extension) completes and checks keys as you type:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=<relative path to>/danbyte/schema/pack.schema.json
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | [format](common.md#format) |  | The library format this file is written for. Optional; the tools write it, and a later format will change the value. |
| `id` | string (pattern) | yes | Stable id, equal to the folder name. |
| `name` | string | yes | Display name. |
| `version` | string (pattern) | yes | Semantic version; Danbyte compares it with the installed one for "update available". |
| `license` | string | yes | SPDX licence of the pack's models and photos (overlays and schema are CC0-1.0 regardless). |
| `author` | string | yes | Who made the models; credited in the catalog and in Danbyte's pack info. |
| `description` | string |  | One paragraph on what the pack holds. |
| `blender` | string or number |  | Blender version the models were exported with. |
| `spec` | string or number |  | Export spec version the models follow. |
| `requires` | list of string (pattern) |  | Other packs this one needs installed for everything in it to draw and connect, by id: a switch pack needs the connectors its cabled ports show. Danbyte warns when one is missing; it does not refuse the install. |
| `types` | mapping | yes | The entries, by kind. |

### types

The entries, by kind.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device` | [refs](#refs) |  | Device overlays: `danbyte/overlays/<ref>.yaml`. |
| `module` | [refs](#refs) |  | Module overlays: `danbyte/module-overlays/<ref>.yaml`. |
| `pluggable` | [refs](#refs) |  | Pluggables: `danbyte/pluggables/<ref>.yaml`. |
| `rack-kit` | [refs](#refs) |  | Rack kits: `danbyte/racks/kits/<ref>/kit.yaml`. |
| `rack-type` | [refs](#refs) |  | Rack types: `danbyte/racks/types/<ref>.yaml`. |

Example:

```yaml
id: cisco-catalyst-9500
name: Cisco Catalyst 9500
version: 1.6.15
license: CC-BY-4.0
author: A. Modeller
types:
  device: [Cisco/C9300-24P]
  module: [Cisco/FAN-T2]
  pluggable: [Generic/RJ45-PLUG]
```
